latest.title: Automating Software Delivery with AWS: A Beginner’s Guide to CI/CD
latest.description: Building an application is only one part of software development. Developers also need a reliable way to test changes, package code, and deploy updates without introducing unnecessary errors. Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) help automate this process.

latest.title: Add Generative AI to Your App with the Amazon Bedrock Converse API
latest.description: Adding generative AI to an application used to mean choosing a model provider, learning its API, managing keys, and rewriting everything when you wanted to try a different model. Amazon Bedrock simplifies this: one managed service, many foundation models, and your data stays inside your AWS account’s security boundary.

latest.title: Amazon CloudFront Explained: How to Make Your Website Faster Worldwide
latest.description: Why can a website load quickly for users in one country but slowly for users in another? In this article, I explore Amazon CloudFront, how content delivery networks work, and how CloudFront helps deliver website content with lower latency, improved performance, and better security.

latest.title: Building Event-Driven Workflows with AWS Step Functions
latest.description: Explore how AWS Step Functions simplifies workflow orchestration with visual state machines, error handling, and coordination between cloud services.

latest.title: Build a Serverless URL Shortener on AWS in 20 Minutes with Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB
latest.description:
Serverless is one of the quickest ways to get a real application running on AWS. You write the logic, AWS runs it, and you pay only when it’s used. In this tutorial we’ll build a URL shortener with an HTTP API, two Lambda functions, and a DynamoDB table, all defined as code with the AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM).
By the end you’ll have a live API that:
Accepts a long URL and returns a short code ( POST /links )

Redirects visitors from the short code to the original URL ( GET /{code} )

latest.title: From Zero to Containers on AWS: A Beginner's Guide to Docker, Amazon ECR, and Amazon ECS
latest.description: Discover how containers simplify application deployment and how AWS services help you take an application from your local machine to the cloud. This beginner-friendly guide explains Docker, Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR), and Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS), along with their roles in a practical container deployment workflow.

latest.title: How Infrastructure as Code Simplifies Cloud Management
latest.description: Discover how Infrastructure as Code helps developers automate AWS resource provisioning, maintain consistent environments, and manage infrastructure changes reliably.

latest.title: My third merged Serverless Land PR: semantic search with Bedrock and DynamoDB
latest.description: A technical walkthrough of API contracts, embeddings, DynamoDB vector indexes, IAM, deployment, and testing—plus a practical guide to contributing a Serverless Land pattern.

latest.title: Amazon S3 Best Practices: Building Secure and Reliable Cloud Storage
latest.description: Cloud applications generate and store different types of data, including images, documents, backups, and application files. Choosing a reliable storage solution is important, but storing data in the cloud also requires careful attention to security, accessibility, and cost.

latest.title: Building Trustworthy AI Applications with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
latest.description: Learn how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can help AI applications answer questions using your own documents. This practical guide explains the architecture, implementation workflow, Python example, and key considerations for building more reliable generative AI applications with Amazon Bedrock.
